items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉Fed會議紀錄放鷹 黃金重挫逾3%跌破3800美元
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Fed Meeting Minutes Turn Hawkish, Gold Plummets Over 3% Below $3,800
paras: 黃金周三(18日)重挫逾3%，觸及逾一年低點，來自聯準會(Fed)的鷹派訊號讓投資人對升息預期加溫，提振美元和美債殖利率，進而打壓黃金。

黃金現貨下跌3.2%，報每盎司3726.19美元，盤中最低觸及3719.55美元，創2025年9月以來新低。
美國12月黃金期貨收低3.2%，報每盎司3741.90美元。


Fed公布10月會議紀錄顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心可能需要加強控制通膨的力道，即使當時決定暫時維持利率不變。
獨立分析師Tai Wong說：「Fed會議紀錄對黃金市場幾乎沒有帶來任何喘息空間，因為絕大多數官員都認為需要進一步升息，其中有幾人甚至提到，若通膨數據令人失望，不排除升息2碼(50個基點)。」
他指出，Fed將持續升息，直到通膨出現轉折，但目前還不到緊急應對的程度。除非市場迅速反轉，否則周三的跌勢意味著未來幾周金價可能進一步測試3350至3450美元區間。
會議紀錄也呼應Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)的鷹派談話。華勒日前表示，Fed需要對通膨採取更積極的應對措施，12月應升息2碼，或對外傳達2027年將加快升息步調的訊號。
Fed官員威廉斯(John Williams)與穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)也釋出訊號，認為為了抑制通膨，未來可能仍有必要進一步升息。
Zaye Capital Markets投資長Naeem Aslam表示，這波金價拋售反映美元走強、美國公債殖利率攀升，以及市場對進一步貨幣緊縮政策的預期，正形成愈來愈大的壓力。
受到Fed官員鷹派談話及近期經濟數據影響，市場對下個月升息的預期更加確立，美元周三升至19個月新高。目前市場預估12月升息2碼的機率為7.3%，高於10月會議紀錄公布前的5.3%。
利率走高會增加持有黃金這類不具利息收益資產的機會成本，進一步削弱黃金吸引力。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌5%，報每盎司45.03美元，盤中一度觸及2025年9月以來新低。
現貨白金下跌4.1%，報1370.70美元，盤中同樣創2025年9月以來新低。
現貨鈀金下跌2.2%，報每盎司949美元。
paras_en: Gold slumped more than 3% on Wednesday (the 18th), hitting a one‑year low, as hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve heightened investors' expectations of further rate hikes, boosting the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields and thereby pressuring gold.

Spot gold fell 3.2% to $3,726.19 per ounce, with an intraday low of $3,719.55, a new low since September 2025. December U.S. gold futures closed down 3.2% at $3,741.90 per ounce. The Fed’s release of the October meeting minutes showed that policymakers are increasingly worried they may need to tighten inflation control even though they had decided to keep rates unchanged for now.

Independent analyst Tai Wong said: “The Fed minutes left virtually no breathing room for the gold market, as the overwhelming majority of officials think further rate hikes are needed, with some even mentioning a possible 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) increase if inflation data disappoints.”

He noted that the Fed will keep raising rates until inflation shows a turning point, but it is not yet at a level that demands emergency action. Unless the market reverses quickly, Wednesday’s drop suggests gold could test the $3,350‑$3,450 range in the coming weeks.

The minutes also echoed the hawkish remarks of Fed Governor Christopher Waller, who recently said the Fed needs to take a more aggressive stance on inflation, should raise rates by two points in December, or signal an accelerated tightening path for 2027.
Fed officials John Williams and Alberto Musalem also signaled that further rate hikes may still be necessary to curb inflation.

Zaye Capital Markets’ Chief Investment Officer Naeem Aslam said the sell‑off in gold reflects a stronger dollar, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and market expectations of further monetary tightening, creating growing pressure on the metal.

Affected by hawkish comments from Fed officials and recent economic data, market expectations for a rate hike next month have solidified, pushing the dollar to a 19‑month high on Wednesday. The market now estimates a 7.3% probability of a two‑point hike in December, up from 5.3% before the minutes were released.
Higher rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non‑interest‑bearing assets like gold, further diminishing its appeal.

Other precious metals: Spot silver fell 5% to $45.03 per ounce, briefly hitting a new low since September 2025. Spot platinum dropped 4.1% to $1,370.70, also marking a September‑2025 low. Spot palladium fell 2.2% to $949 per ounce.

items.title: 穆迪下調輝達評等展望至「穩定」
items.title_en: Moody's Lowers Nvidia's Outlook to "Stable"
paras: 穆迪信評(Moody’s Ratings)週三(18日)將輝達(NVDA-US)評等展望由「正向」(Positive) 調整為「穩定」(Stable)，理由是黃仁勳突然離職、缺乏正式接班計畫，以及相關政府調查帶來的公司治理不確定性。不過，穆迪仍肯定輝達強勁的財務實力與市場地位，維持其Aa1優先無擔保債務評等及Prime-1短期商業本票計畫評等。
穆迪資深副總裁 Raj Joshi 表示：「將評等展望調整為穩定，反映我們認為，儘管輝達的市場領導地位與財務狀況仍極為強勁，但未來12至18個月不太可能調升評等。」
輝達 11 月 12 日震撼宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效。董事會正尋找正式接班人，由財務長暨執行副總裁克瑞斯(Colette Kress)兼任代理執行長。
穆迪指出，關鍵主管突然離職，加上缺乏正式接班計畫，是此次調整展望的主要原因。
此外，與黃仁勳辭職前相關事件有關、尚未結束的政府調查，也可能分散管理層注意力。
儘管領導交接與治理風險升高，輝達的財務緩衝仍相當充裕。
穆迪指出，評等調整當時，輝達持有980億美元現金及有價證券，相較之下，債務與租賃負債合計約390億美元。
穆迪預估，輝達2027會計年度營收將成長96%，2028會計年度營收則可望達到7,460億美元。
不過，輝達對AI基礎設施的擔保承諾，也是評估其信用風險的重要環節。
穆迪指出，輝達承擔約1,180億美元擔保，主要涉及俄亥俄州樸次茅斯(Portsmouth)資料中心園區，與OpenAI租賃付款相關的剩餘價值擔保。相關義務預計自2028年開始，並於2031年達到高峰。
至於後續評等方向，穆迪表示，若輝達能維持領先市占率、新管理層承諾採取保守財務政策，並持續保有卓越財務實力，仍可能獲得調升評等。
反之，若AI基礎設施需求轉弱、公司面臨執行挑戰、財務政策改變，或地緣政治風險升高並衝擊供應鏈，都可能構成調降評等的原因。
此次展望調整顯示，穆迪仍認可輝達的信用實力，但在領導交接與調查結果尚未明朗前，對進一步升評採取較審慎態度。
paras_en: Moody's Investors Service on Wednesday (the 18th) changed Nvidia's (NVDA-US) rating outlook from "Positive" to "Stable," citing Jensen Huang's sudden departure, the lack of a formal succession plan, and governance uncertainty stemming from related government investigations. Nonetheless, Moody's still affirms Nvidia's strong financial strength and market position, maintaining its Aa1 senior unsecured debt rating and Prime-1 short‑term commercial paper rating.

Senior Vice President Raj Joshi said, "Shifting the outlook to Stable reflects our view that, although Nvidia's market leadership and financial condition remain very strong, an upgrade is unlikely over the next 12 to 18 months."

Nvidia shocked the market on November 12 by announcing that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately. The board is searching for a permanent successor, with CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.
Moody's noted that the abrupt departure of a key executive, combined with the absence of a formal succession plan, was the primary driver of the outlook change.
In addition, ongoing government investigations related to events preceding Huang's resignation could also divert management's attention.
Despite the heightened leadership transition and governance risks, Nvidia's financial cushion remains ample.
Moody's pointed out that at the time of the rating adjustment, Nvidia held $98 billion in cash and marketable securities, versus roughly $39 billion in debt and lease liabilities combined.
Moody's projects Nvidia's fiscal 2027 revenue to grow 96% and fiscal 2028 revenue to reach $746 billion.
However, Nvidia's guarantee commitments for AI infrastructure are also a key factor in assessing its credit risk.

Moody's indicated that Nvidia has assumed about $118 billion of guarantees, primarily tied to the Portsmouth, Ohio data‑center campus and residual value guarantees linked to OpenAI lease payments. These obligations are expected to start in 2028 and peak in 2031.

Regarding future rating direction, Moody's said that if Nvidia maintains its leading market share, the new management commits to a conservative financial policy, and it continues to possess outstanding financial strength, an upgrade remains possible.
Conversely, a weakening of AI infrastructure demand, execution challenges, changes to financial policy, or heightened geopolitical risks affecting the supply chain could trigger a downgrade.

The outlook adjustment shows that Moody's still recognizes Nvidia's credit strength, but adopts a more cautious stance on further upgrades until the leadership transition and investigation outcomes become clearer.

items.title: 傳Anthropic每股定價83美元 總募資破940億美元、超車SpaceX創史上最大IPO
items.title_en: Anthropic Sets Share Price at $83, Total Funding Over $94 Billion, Overtakes SpaceX for Largest IPO Ever
paras: 知情人士透露，Anthropic PBC已將首次公開發行(IPO)價格定為每股83美元，高於原先對外公布的價格區間，成為史上規模最大的首次公開發行股票案。Anthropic股票預定周四在那斯達克全球精選市場(Nasdaq Global Select Market)掛牌交易，股票代號為「ANT」。
知情人士表示，此次發行規模也已擴大。根據公司申報文件，Anthropic原先規劃發行8億140萬股，七名共同創辦人則提供2360萬股，原定價格區間為每股70至78美元。此外，Anthropic也將以IPO定價進行260億美元私募配售。
由於定價高於原先區間，Anthropic將透過IPO至少募資680億美元，加上260億美元的私募配售後，整體募資規模將超過940億美元，超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月750億美元的基本IPO募資規模。SpaceX後續行使俗稱「超額配售權」的選項後，募資總額增至862億美元。
彭博周日報導，承銷銀行先前已向投資人說明，Anthropic IPO認購需求接近發行規模的七倍。
前沿AI實驗室首度上市 OpenAI進度落後
Anthropic將成為史上首家IPO的前沿人工智慧(AI)實驗室，這類企業致力於開發最先進的模型，協助使用者處理軟體設計、法律工作及科學研究等複雜任務。
掛牌之後，Anthropic的上市進度也明顯領先競爭對手OpenAI，後者目前並未計劃在2027年以前上市。
不過，Anthropic上市的時機微妙，市場環境壓力沉重。那斯達克100指數在截至周三(18日)收盤為止一周下跌4.4%，輝達(NVDA-US)雖然公布優於市場預期的財報，周三收盤股價仍下跌2.9%，連續第五個交易日走跌。
根據申報文件，輝達將參與Anthropic私募配售，認購100億美元股票。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周五在一場活動中接受摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)訪問時說：「我們不會太在意究竟何時、哪個月、哪一天，或是在什麼市場環境下上市。」
阿莫戴也透露，在整個上市過程中，自己得到最好的建議是：「絕不要讓公司的價值比它真正應有的價值高出哪怕1美元。」
此次上市可望讓阿莫戴這位共同創辦人、以及許多Anthropic員工的個人財富大為成長，也將提高創投投資人的投資回報。投資人包括Iconiq、Coatue Management及在Anthropic董事會擁有席次的Spark Capital。
高盛(GS-US)與摩根士丹利(MS-US)將擔任Anthropic IPO的主辦承銷商，另有20家銀行參與。
paras_en: Insiders disclosed that Anthropic PBC has set its initial public offering (IPO) price at $83 per share, above the previously announced price range, making it the largest IPO ever in terms of scale. Anthropic’s stock is slated to begin trading on Thursday on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker “ANT.”

Sources said the offering size has also been expanded. According to the company’s filing, Anthropic originally planned to issue 814 million shares, with the seven co‑founders contributing 23.6 million shares, and the original price range was $70‑$78 per share. In addition, Anthropic will conduct a $26 billion private placement at the IPO price.

Because the price is higher than the original range, Anthropic will raise at least $68 billion through the IPO; combined with the $26 billion private placement, total proceeds will exceed $94 billion, surpassing SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) base IPO proceeds of $75 billion in June this year. After SpaceX exercised its so‑called “overallotment” option, its total raised amount rose to $86.2 billion.
Bloomberg reported on Sunday that the underwriting banks had previously told investors that demand for the Anthropic IPO was close to seven times the size of the offering.
Frontier AI lab lists for the first time, OpenAI lags behind

Anthropic will become the first frontier artificial‑intelligence (AI) lab to go public; such companies focus on developing cutting‑edge models to help users tackle complex tasks such as software design, legal work and scientific research.
After listing, Anthropic’s progress will be clearly ahead of rival OpenAI, which currently has no plans to go public before 2027.

However, the timing of Anthropic’s listing is delicate, with heavy market‑environment pressure. The Nasdaq‑100 index fell 4.4% for the week ending Wednesday (the 18th) at the close, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) – despite posting earnings above market expectations – saw its share price close down 2.9% on Wednesday, marking a fifth consecutive trading‑day decline.
According to the filing, Nvidia will participate in Anthropic’s private placement, subscribing for $10 billion of stock.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei told JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon in an interview last Friday that “we don’t really care about the exact month, day or market environment in which we list.”
Amodei also revealed that the best advice he received during the entire listing process was: “Never let the company’s valuation be even $1 higher than what it truly deserves.”

The listing is expected to greatly increase the personal wealth of Amodei, a co‑founder, and many Anthropic employees, and will boost returns for venture‑capital investors. Investors include Iconiq, Coatue Management and Spark Capital, which holds a seat on Anthropic’s board.
Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) will serve as lead underwriters for the Anthropic IPO, with another 20 banks participating.

items.title: 輝達財報利多失靈 投資人開始擔憂黃仁勳接班問題
items.title_en: Nvidia Earnings Boost Fails to Help; Investors Worry About Jensen Huang Succession
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)多方投資人再度面臨現實考驗，而這場風波如今已進入第二週。也就是說，少了有遠見的黃仁勳坐鎮，輝達似乎就只是一家普通的晶片公司，而且還得設法找人填補高層那件標誌性黑色皮衣所留下的巨大空缺。
這家科技巨頭的股價週三(18日)大幅反轉，回吐財報公布後最初的漲幅。終場下跌2.89%，報每股150.96美元，扭轉盤前近4%的漲幅。
Oppenheimer分析師Rich Schafer表示，「我們認為，近期遭撤換的創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳，是一位獨一無二的領導者，他離開後留下了幾乎不可能填補的空缺。黃仁勳的離開造成領導真空，而自然界（以及投資人）都無法容忍真空的存在。」
Schafer表示，考量到股價波動劇烈，他目前仍未對輝達股票設定目標價。他在幾天前已撤回原先的目標價。
臨時執行長Colette Kress週二晚間提出了充分理由，說明自己可能會比華爾街預期更長時間留任臨時執行長。至少，她證明了輝達並非由一群毫無經驗、不夠格與黃仁勳級別高層同台共事的人所領導。
輝達第三季財報表現穩健，財測也相當強勁，而Kress在財報電話會議上的表現，則展現出穩定掌舵這艘輝達火箭的能力。
輝達第三季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為2.68美元，營收達1,158億美元。華爾街原先預期每股盈餘為2.47美元，營收為1,091.5億美元。
輝達預估第四季營收將達1,274億至1,326億美元，明顯高於分析師預期的1,252.5億美元。
公司表示，預期2028會計年度營收將成長75%，高於僅僅三個月前提出的70%預估。
然而，業界人士告訴我們，與Kress一同出席財報電話會議的輝達新任董事長Harvey Jones，在說明尋找黃仁勳接班人的時程時，卻搞砸了溝通。Jones對於延攬一位能力出眾的正式執行長，似乎缺乏急迫感，對一家身處AI熱潮核心的晶片公司而言，這並不是市場在緊張情緒下想聽到的答案。
Seaport Research Partners分析師Jay Goldberg在「Sozzi Unleashed」節目中表示，「不過，我不確定任何一位內部人選是否有能力管理整家公司。黃仁勳向來以自己為核心打造公司的組織架構，就像輪子的中心，所有事物都與他相連。我不認為任何內部人士對公司的整體掌握程度，能像黃仁勳那麼全面。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) investors are once again facing a reality check, and the turmoil has now entered its second week. In other words, without visionary Jensen Huang at the helm, Nvidia seems just like an ordinary chip maker and must find someone to fill the huge void left by the iconic black leather jacket of its top executive.
The tech giant’s stock swung sharply on Wednesday (the 18th), giving back much of the post‑earnings rally. It closed down 2.89% at $150.96 per share, erasing the near‑4% pre‑market gain.

Oppenheimer analyst Rich Schafer said, “We believe the recently ousted founder‑CEO Jensen Huang is a one‑of‑a‑kind leader, and his departure leaves an almost impossible‑to‑fill void. Huang’s exit creates a leadership vacuum that neither nature nor investors can tolerate.”
Schafer noted that, given the extreme stock volatility, he has not set a price target for Nvidia shares and withdrew his previous target just a few days ago.

Interim CEO Colette Kress gave ample reasons on Tuesday night that she may stay in the interim role longer than Wall Street expects. At the very least, she proved that Nvidia is not being run by a group of inexperienced, unqualified people sharing the stage with a Huang‑level executive.
Nvidia’s third‑quarter results were solid and its outlook strong, and Kress’s performance in the earnings call demonstrated her ability to steer the Nvidia rocket steadily.
Nvidia reported adjusted Q3 earnings of $2.68 per share on revenue of $115.8 billion. Wall Street had originally expected $2.47 EPS and $109.15 billion in revenue.
Nvidia forecasts Q4 revenue of $127.4 billion to $132.6 billion, well above analysts’ estimate of $125.25 billion.
The company said it expects fiscal‑2028 revenue to grow 75%, higher than the 70% forecast it gave just three months ago.

However, industry sources said that new board chair Harvey Jones, who joined the earnings call with Kress, botched the communication about the timeline for finding Huang’s successor. Jones seemed to lack urgency in hiring a capable permanent CEO, a response that does not soothe market nerves for a chip firm at the heart of the AI boom.

Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg said on the “Sozzi Unleashed” show, “I’m not sure any internal candidate can manage the whole company. Huang built the organization around himself, like the hub of a wheel, with everything connected to him. I don’t think any insider has the same comprehensive grasp of the company as Huang does.”

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉輝達財報難救股價！道瓊挫逾560點 標普連五黑 那指逆勢翻紅
items.title_en: U.S. After‑Hours: Nvidia’s Earnings Fail to Rescue Stock; Dow Down Over 560 Points, S&P Posts Fifth Straight Decline, Nasdaq Gains Against the Trend
paras: 美股週三 (18 日) 漲跌不一。輝達財報與營收展望未能化解市場對領導交接及人工智慧 (AI) 投資前景的疑慮，加上聯準會釋出進一步升息訊號，道瓊終場下跌逾 561 點，逼近修正區間，標普 500 指數連續第五個交易日收黑，創 6 月以來最長連跌紀錄。
不過，市場對 AI 新創 Anthropic 上市的期待，帶動亞馬遜、Alphabet 與博通等相關個股走強，支撐那斯達克指數逆勢上漲 0.42%，費城半導體指數也小幅收紅。
醫療保健、能源與工業股則承受賣壓，聯合健康下跌約 10%，雪佛龍跌近 4%，開拓重工跌逾 2%，拖累道瓊表現。
美股週三 (18 日) 主要指數表現：
AI 新創 Anthropic 上市成為市場焦點。據《彭博》報導，公司 IPO 定價為每股 83 美元，高於原先每股 70 至 78 美元的承銷區間，另將以相同價格籌集 260 億美元私募資金。公司預定週四 (19 日) 掛牌，相關題材帶動投資股東亞馬遜、Alphabet 及合作夥伴博通走強。
不過，市場對 AI 投資回報與競爭格局仍有疑慮。瑞銀指出，投資人可能低估中國的 AI 競爭力，以及企業需求分散的影響；未來關鍵不只是資本支出成長速度，更在於誰能掌握基礎設施、資料與商業化收益。
美中俄元首齊聚深圳，市場關注三方互動，以及會談對地緣政治、貿易與能源局勢的影響。
同時，美伊衝突再度升溫，油價收低並拖累能源股。美軍打擊荷姆茲海峽的伊朗格什姆島後，伊朗週三宣稱攻擊科威特境內美軍無人機與飛彈設施，巴林也通報攔截伊朗攻擊，區域衝突進一步擴大。
此外，聯準會 10 月會議紀錄顯示，幾乎所有與會官員都認為，未來幾個月可能需要進一步升息，並將 AI 相關需求視為重要通膨風險。
鷹派理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 週三更主張，12 月可能需要升息 2 碼，或先升息 1 碼並明確預告隔年 1 月再度行動。
不過，官員對緊縮速度仍有分歧，紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John Williams) 認為，目前情勢尚不需要採取劇烈行動。
焦點個股
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數收紅。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.40%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 0.15%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.80%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 0.40%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 強漲 3.82%。
半導體焦點股互有消長。AMD (AMD-US) 大漲 5.31%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 3.64%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 2.89%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 0.88%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 4.12%。
記憶體族群與儲存族群互見漲跌。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 1.00%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 1.72%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 2.64%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 2.28%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 0.11%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 0.81%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 2.17%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 1.27%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 0.49%。
企業新聞
輝達(NVDA-US)週三股價震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。
AI巨頭輝達週二盤後繳出營收倍增、獲利優於預期的亮眼財報，並預估截至 2028 年 1 月的會計年度營收將成長 75%，同時擴大股票回購計畫，仍難消市場對領導交接與監管風險的疑慮。
輝達董事長瓊斯 (Harvey Jones) 在週二法說會開場重申，董事會無意讓黃仁勳重返執行長職位。據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，獵頭公司海德思哲 (Heidrick & Struggles) 已就輝達執行長職缺接觸安謀執行長哈斯 (Rene Haas)，但報導未指雙方已達成人事安排。
零售商 Target (TGT-US) 上漲 4.01%，收每股 165.93 美元。公司第三季淨銷售額成長 7.1%，創逾五年最佳增幅；同店銷售成長 5.6%，優於市場預期的 3.8%，同店來客數增加 5%，顯示轉型措施逐步反映在業績上。
電玩發行商 Take-Two Interactive (TTWO-US) 衝高 6.22%。這家電玩發行商預定週四推出《俠盜獵車手 VI》 (Grand Theft Auto VI)，《巴隆》先前曾撰文看好其股票，認為值得買進。
近期多起備受矚目的軟體服務中斷事件令華爾街不安，帶動資安股上漲。Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) 在盤後公布財報前上漲 9.9%，Okta (OKTA-US) 與 CrowdStrike (CRWD-US) 分別噴高約 12% 及 8%。
華爾街分析
Great Valley Advisor Group 市場策略師 Eric Parnell 表示，市場需要時間適應輝達的領導層變動，但最終仍會逐步消化這項衝擊。
他認為，AI 投資的基本挑戰並未改變，包括龐大的資本支出與債務融資需求。在目前的 AI 建設與支出環境下，企業獲利成長只要稍微放緩，就可能讓相關股票迅速下跌。他預期，這類波動不僅會持續，甚至可能在 2027 年至 2028 年加劇。
《Innovation Investor》編輯 Luke Lango 則指出，輝達強勁的財測與回購措施，仍未回答投資人最在意的問題：「這家公司一年後會是什麼模樣？」答案將取決於未來幾週至幾個月的發展。
NewEdge Wealth 董事總經理 Jay Peters 表示，Anthropic 的 IPO 看來具備穩固需求，考量該公司是 AI 基礎設施的重要客戶，順利上市將為整個 AI 生態系帶來正面訊號。

paras_en: U.S. stocks on Wednesday (the 18th) were mixed. Nvidia’s earnings and revenue outlook did not allay market concerns over the leadership transition and the outlook for artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment, and the Fed’s signal of further rate hikes pushed the Dow down more than 561 points, bringing it close to a correction zone, while the S&P 500 logged its fifth consecutive losing day, the longest streak since June.

However, market enthusiasm for AI start‑up Anthropic’s IPO lifted related names such as Amazon, Alphabet and Broadcom, helping the Nasdaq climb 0.42% against the trend and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index close modestly in the green.
Healthcare, energy and industrial stocks faced selling pressure, with UnitedHealth down about 10%, Chevron falling nearly 4% and Konecranes slipping over 2%, dragging the Dow lower.
U.S. market performance on Wednesday (the 18th) for the major indices:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 561.25 points, or 1.11%, to 50,198.17. The Nasdaq rose 101.50 points, or 0.42%, to 24,429.89. The S&P 500 slipped 16.90 points, or 0.23%, to 7,323.63. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 9.92 points, or 0.10%, to 9,652.80. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 108.85 points, or 0.65%, to 16,798.84.

AI start‑up Anthropic’s IPO became a market focus. Bloomberg reported the IPO was priced at $83 per share, above the original $70‑$78 underwriting range, and the company will also raise $26 billion of private placement capital at the same price. Anthropic is slated to list on Thursday (the 19th), and the news boosted investor‑heavyweights Amazon, Alphabet and partner Broadcom.

Nevertheless, doubts remain about AI investment returns and competitive dynamics. UBS warned investors may be underestimating China’s AI competitiveness and the impact of fragmented corporate demand; going forward, the key issue is not just the pace of cap‑ex growth but who controls the infrastructure, data and commercialization revenue.
The leaders of the United States, China and Russia gathered in Shenzhen, prompting markets to watch the three‑way interaction and its implications for geopolitics, trade and energy.

At the same time, renewed U.S.–Iran tensions pushed oil prices lower and weighed on energy stocks. After the U.S. struck Iran’s Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran claimed on Wednesday it attacked U.S. drones and missile sites in Kuwait, and Bahrain reported intercepting Iranian attacks, further expanding the regional conflict.

In addition, the Fed’s October meeting minutes showed that almost every participant believed further rate hikes may be needed in the coming months and flagged AI‑related demand as a notable inflation risk.

Hawkish Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Wednesday that a 25‑basis‑point hike could be required in December, or alternatively a 25‑basis‑point move now followed by a clear indication of another hike in January.
However, officials remain split on the pace of tightening; New York Fed President John Williams argued that conditions do not yet warrant drastic action.
Focus Stocks

Most of the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index closed higher. Meta (META‑US) fell 0.40%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 0.15%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) gained 0.80%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 0.40%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) surged 3.82%.

Semiconductor focus stocks showed mixed moves. AMD (AMD‑US) jumped 5.31%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 3.64%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) fell 2.89%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) gained 0.88%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) dropped 4.12%.

Memory and storage groups saw both gains and losses. Micron (MU‑US) fell 1.00%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) rose 1.72%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) dropped 2.64%; Seagate (STX‑US) climbed 2.28%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) slipped 0.11%.
Taiwan‑related ADRs mostly rose. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) gained 0.81%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) rose 2.17%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) fell 1.27%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) rose 0.49%.
Company News

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) saw its share price wobble into the red on Wednesday, ending down 2.89% at $150.96. Since CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation announcement, the stock has fallen a cumulative 13.11% over five trading sessions.

AI giant Nvidia delivered an after‑hours earnings report on Tuesday that showed revenue doubling and profit beating expectations, and it forecast fiscal‑year revenue ending January 2028 to grow 75% while expanding its share‑repurchase program, yet the market’s concerns over the leadership transition and regulatory risk persisted.

Nvidia board chair Harvey Jones reiterated at Tuesday’s earnings call that the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO. Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles has approached AMD CEO Rene Haas about the Nvidia CEO vacancy, though no agreement has been reached.

Retailer Target (TGT‑US) rose 4.01% to $165.93 per share. The company reported third‑quarter net sales up 7.1%, the best growth in over five years, with comparable‑store sales up 5.6% versus market expectations of 3.8% and comparable‑store traffic up 5%, indicating that its transformation initiatives are beginning to show in results.

Video‑game publisher Take‑Two Interactive (TTWO‑US) surged 6.22%. The publisher plans to launch Grand Theft Auto VI on Thursday, and the research note “Baron” previously gave the stock a buy recommendation.

A spate of high‑profile software‑service outages recently unsettled Wall Street, lifting cybersecurity stocks. Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) jumped 9.9% before its after‑hours earnings release, while Okta (OKTA‑US) and CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) surged roughly 12% and 8% respectively.
Wall Street Analysis
Great Valley Advisor Group market strategist Eric Parnell said the market needs time to absorb Nvidia’s leadership change, but eventually the shock will be digested gradually.

He added that the fundamental challenges of AI investment remain unchanged, including massive cap‑ex and debt‑financing needs. In the current AI build‑out environment, even a modest slowdown in corporate profit growth can trigger sharp stock declines. He expects such volatility to persist and possibly intensify in 2027‑2028.

Innovation Investor editor Luke Lango noted that despite Nvidia’s strong guidance and buy‑back plans, investors’ biggest question remains: “What will the company look like a year from now?” The answer will depend on developments over the coming weeks and months.

NewEdge Wealth managing director Jay Peters said Anthropic’s IPO appears to have solid demand, and because the company is a key AI‑infrastructure customer, a successful listing will send a positive signal to the broader AI ecosystem.

paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)繳出營收倍增、獲利優於預期的亮眼財報，並上調下個會計年度成長展望，仍難消市場對領導交接與監管風險的疑慮。輝達股價週三(18日) 震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。
華爾街分析師指出，執行長接班、AI生態系投資能否延續、中國透過第三方取得晶片，以及美國最新出口管制的影響，是壓抑股價的四大未解問題。
輝達週二公布第三季營收達1,158.4億美元，年增103.2%，高於分析師預估的1,088.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘為2.68美元，也優於市場預期的2.47美元。其中，最大業務資料中心營收年增110%，達1,076億美元。
公司預估，本季營收約1,300億美元，並將2028會計年度營收成長預期，由原先的70%上調至75%。
Jefferies分析師表示，營收與獲利優於預期、財測上調，加上2028會計年度展望提高，與近期市場對AI的悲觀情緒形成反差，也顯示輝達產品需求依然強勁。
不過，Jefferies 也提醒：「AI基礎建設擴張的速度，以及最終是否出現需求空窗，仍存在疑問，但我們也要強調，目前估值已反映相當程度的疑慮。」
首先，黃仁勳離任後的接班安排，仍是市場最難評估的變數。
這是黃仁勳上週請辭後，輝達首次公布財報。新任董事長瓊斯(Harvey Jones)在法說會上明確表示，儘管科技界部分人士呼籲黃仁勳回歸，董事會仍無意讓他重掌執行長職位。
TD Cowen分析師 Joshua Buchalter 認為，考量目前情勢，輝達已在法說會上盡可能回應執行長交接相關疑慮，但未來由誰領導公司，仍帶來「極大的」不確定性。
伯恩斯坦(Bernstein)分析師 Stacy Rasgon 表示，他與團隊「仍較傾向認為，黃仁勳離任將帶來問題，而遺憾的是，目前經過的時間還遠遠不足以證實或推翻這些擔憂」。
第二項疑慮，是輝達所處的AI生態系，能否持續支撐龐大的晶片需求。
Jefferies 分析師 Blayne Curtis指出，輝達成長仍與主要AI實驗室的支出密切相關，而這些支出「大致不在」輝達掌控之中。雖然公司的需求強度「令人難以質疑」，投資人仍需要看到整體AI生態系維持穩健，才能降低對未來展望的不安。
輝達不僅向OpenAI及Anthropic供應晶片，也持有這兩家公司的大量股權。這種同時擔任供應商與投資人的角色，使市場關注其客戶需求與資金來源之間的關係，以及AI基礎建設投資最終能否創造足夠回報。
代理執行長暨財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)在法說會上表示，輝達未來對AI供應鏈的投資將保持嚴謹。
「我們一直支持這個生態系的發展，也會繼續以有紀律、有選擇性的方式提供支持。」她說，「我們確實擁有一些非常、非常強大的既有客戶，未來也會持續與他們合作。」
另一方面，為了因應需求，輝達的供應承諾已由前一季的2,790億美元，增加至3,900億美元，主要來自多年期記憶體採購。雲端服務協議與資料中心租賃承諾，也從740億美元增至1,020億美元，顯示公司仍持續為後續業務擴張投入資源。
第三項疑慮，則是中國企業是否透過海外中介與資料中心，間接取得受出口管制的輝達晶片或運算服務。
Seaport Research分析師 Jay Goldberg 指出，對於亞洲資料中心向中國AI實驗室提供服務所引發的疑慮，輝達在法說會上「完全沒有釋疑」。
他表示，公司強調財測未納入來自中國的Hopper產品營收，但這項回答「過於具體，迴避了更大的問題」。
Hopper是輝達較早一代的晶片架構，市場關注的範圍則包括中國企業透過第三國取得先進運算能力的情況。
克瑞斯表示，輝達本季已認列24億美元、獲准銷往中國的Hopper資料中心產品營收，但未來將停止出貨這類產品，財測也未納入相關營收。
與此相關的監管壓力也持續升高。據《華爾街日報》引述知情人士報導，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)已對輝達展開調查，重點涉及公司揭露資訊是否誤導投資人。
此外，黃仁勳與輝達法務長 Tim Teter 預定於12月初出席美國國會委員會聽證，屆時可能面臨中國業務相關提問。
做空機構渾水(Muddy Waters)也揭露放空輝達，並質疑公司資深高層普里(Jay Puri)與一名前美超微主管之間的關聯，指稱後者可能協助將搭載輝達晶片的伺服器銷往中國企業。
相關說法屬於渾水提出的指控，不能視為已獲證實的違規事實。
第四項疑慮，是美國最新出口管制將如何影響輝達訂單與營收。
美國商務部工業暨安全局(BIS)週一發布暫行最終規則，旨在防止中國企業透過第三國資料中心，以「遠端存取」方式使用受管制的美國AI晶片，相關安排常見於東南亞地區。
Buchalter 指出，新規使輝達業務面臨「額外審查」。雖然管理層有信心將供應轉向其他不受新規影響的客戶，但實際調整效果仍待觀察。
Wolfe Research分析師 Chris Caso 因此選擇不跟隨管理層調高下一年度預測。他表示，目前還太早，無法完整評估出口管制，以及重量級執行長離任所帶來的影響。
面對相關風險，輝達週二宣布成立國家安全與出口管制監督委員會。瓊斯表示，該委員會將協助改善公司與美國官員的溝通。
摩根大通分析師 Harlan Sur 則提醒，在接班與監管等問題尚未釐清前，輝達股價短期內可能持續震盪。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) delivered a dazzling earnings report with revenue doubling and profit beating expectations, and raised its growth outlook for the next fiscal year, yet market worries over leadership transition and regulatory risk remain. Nvidia's stock wavered into the red on Wednesday (the 18th), closing down 2.89% at $150.96 per share, marking a cumulative 13.11% decline over five trading days since the announcement of Jensen Huang's resignation.

Wall Street analysts said the unresolved issues suppressing the stock are the CEO succession, whether AI‑ecosystem investment can be sustained, China obtaining chips through third parties, and the impact of the latest U.S. export controls.

Nvidia reported third‑quarter revenue of $115.84 billion, up 103.2% year‑over‑year and above analysts' estimate of $108.85 billion; adjusted earnings were $2.68 per share, also beating the market forecast of $2.47. The biggest segment, data‑center revenue, grew 110% to $107.6 billion.
The company projects this quarter’s revenue at roughly $130 billion and has lifted its fiscal‑2028 revenue growth target from 70% to 75%.

Jefferies analysts said the beat on revenue and profit, the upward revision of guidance and the higher 2028 outlook contrast with recent market pessimism on AI and show that demand for Nvidia’s products remains robust.

However, Jefferies cautioned that “the speed of AI‑infrastructure expansion and whether a demand gap will eventually emerge remain uncertain, but we also note that current valuation already reflects a substantial amount of the concerns.”
First, the succession plan after Jensen Huang’s departure remains the market’s hardest‑to‑assess variable.

This is Nvidia’s first earnings release since Huang resigned last week. New board chair Harvey Jones told investors at the earnings call that, despite some voices in tech urging Huang’s return, the board has no intention of reinstating him as CEO.

TD Cowen analyst Joshua Buchalter said that given the current situation, Nvidia has addressed the CEO‑transition concerns as best it can at the call, but who will lead the company going forward still creates “significant” uncertainty.

Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon said he and his team “still tend to think Huang’s exit will cause problems, and unfortunately the time that has passed so far is far too short to confirm or refute those worries.”
The second concern is whether Nvidia’s AI ecosystem can continue to sustain the massive chip demand.

Jefferies analyst Blayne Curtis noted that Nvidia’s growth remains closely tied to spending by major AI labs, and that spending is “largely out of Nvidia’s control.” While demand strength is “hard to dispute,” investors need to see the overall AI ecosystem stay healthy to allay outlook anxiety.

Nvidia supplies chips to OpenAI and Anthropic and also holds sizable equity stakes in both firms. This dual role of supplier and investor draws market focus on the relationship between customer demand and funding sources, and whether AI‑infrastructure investment will ultimately generate sufficient returns.
Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress told the earnings call that Nvidia will keep its AI‑supply‑chain investments disciplined.

“We have always supported the development of this ecosystem and will continue to back it in a disciplined, selective way,” she said. “We do have some very, very strong existing customers and will keep working with them moving forward.”

On the demand side, Nvidia’s supply commitments have risen from $279 billion in the prior quarter to $390 billion, mainly from long‑term memory purchases. Cloud service agreements and data‑center leasing commitments also grew from $74 billion to $102 billion, showing the company continues to allocate resources for future expansion.
The third concern is whether Chinese firms are obtaining Nvidia chips or compute services subject to export controls through overseas intermediaries and data centers.
Seaport Research analyst Jay Goldberg said that regarding worries about Asian data centers providing services to Chinese AI labs, Nvidia “provided no clarification at all” during the call.
He added that the company emphasized that its guidance excludes revenue from China’s Hopper products, but that answer was “overly specific and sidestepped the bigger issue.”
Hopper is an older Nvidia chip architecture; the market is watching for Chinese companies obtaining advanced compute power via third‑country channels.

Kress said Nvidia has recognized $2.4 billion of revenue from Hopper data‑center products shipped to China this quarter, but will cease shipments of those products and the guidance does not include that revenue.

Related regulatory pressure is also mounting. According to the Wall Street Journal citing sources, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has opened an investigation into Nvidia, focusing on whether the company’s disclosures misled investors.

In addition, Jensen Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter are slated to appear before a U.S. congressional committee in early December, where they may face questions about China‑related business.

Short‑seller Muddy Waters also disclosed a short position on Nvidia and questioned the link between senior executive Jay Puri and a former AMD executive, alleging the latter may have helped ship Nvidia‑chip servers to Chinese firms.
Those allegations are claims made by Muddy Waters and should not be treated as verified violations.
The fourth concern is how the latest U.S. export controls will affect Nvidia orders and revenue.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security issued a temporary final rule on Monday aimed at preventing Chinese firms from using controlled U.S. AI chips via “remote access” through third‑country data centers, a practice common in Southeast Asia.
Buchalter noted the new rule adds “extra scrutiny” to Nvidia’s business. While management is confident it can shift supply to customers not affected by the rule, the actual impact remains to be seen.

Wolfe Research analyst Chris Caso therefore chose not to follow management in raising next‑year forecasts. He said it is still too early to fully assess the export controls and the effect of a heavyweight CEO departure.

In response to the risks, Nvidia announced on Tuesday the creation of a National Security and Export‑Control Oversight Committee. Jones said the committee will help improve communication between the company and U.S. officials.
JPMorgan analyst Harlan Sur warned that until succession and regulatory questions are clarified, Nvidia’s stock could continue to wobble in the short term.

items.title: 黃仁勳請辭後輝達首場員工大會！代理CEO承諾「12月提前加薪」、「增發股票」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Nvidia Holds First All‑Hands Meeting; Acting CEO Promises Early December Pay Raise and Additional Stock Grants
paras: AI 巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳請辭後，代理執行長暨財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)週三(18日)在首場全體員工大會上承諾，將於12月提前加薪並增加股權獎酬，較原定時程提早數月，藉此安定員工。董事長瓊斯(Harvey Jones)則重申，董事會正評估內外部執行長人選，不會為了加快任命而降低遴選標準。
根據外媒《WIRED》取得的會議發言內容，克瑞斯上台短短幾分鐘，便單刀直入、直接回應員工的薪酬問題。
她透露，員工會前提交約700個問題，其中最多人關心的是薪酬，其次則是要求董事會提高透明度。
「我在這裡要告訴大家，我們最想做的，就是照顧在這裡的每一位員工，確保你們對公司有信心，不必擔心自己的薪酬。」克瑞斯說。
這場員工大會，是輝達新領導團隊在黃仁勳離任後，首次直接向全體員工說明後續安排。
黃仁勳自33年前共同創辦公司以來，一直擔任領導者，他在季度員工大會上的演說，也成為部分員工備受期待的公司傳統。如今，這家擁有近4.9萬名員工的晶片巨頭，正面臨領導交接與人才留任的雙重考驗。
許多員工長期留任，與黃仁勳的願景及領導風格密不可分。
在AI晶片競爭加劇之際，管理層變動是否引發人才流失，也成為市場關注的風險。
儘管已有數千名員工表達支持黃仁勳復職，另有科技業人士參與公開連署，董事會仍持續推進接班人遴選。
董事長瓊斯在週三員工大會上表示，董事會接受黃仁勳辭呈，原因包括其個人行為及「未能坦誠以告」。
他強調，公司不會尋找「黃仁勳的複製版」，而是要找到兼具才智、高科技工程經驗、策略思考能力、文化契合度與成功實績的領導人。
「我們不會為了求快，而降低要求。」瓊斯說，董事會也願意接受員工對執行長人選的建議，目前正同步評估內外部候選人。
黃仁勳上週在婚外情爭議中請辭，相關指控還涉及其中一名對象可能與中國情報單位有關，相關疑慮仍待調查釐清。
除了薪酬與接班安排，如何延續公司文化，也是這場員工大會的討論重點。
共同創辦人馬拉霍夫斯基(Chris Malachowsky)在與克瑞斯的簡短問答中表示，公司文化不在於牆上的標語，而在於每個人日常的行為、合作與工作方式。
他回憶，創辦團隊過去認為，把文化價值印在海報上的做法「毫無意義」，真正重要的是將其落實於工作之中。
他相信，這些價值能經得起時間考驗，並告訴員工：「我們會沒事的。」
克瑞斯則在這場約50分鐘的會議尾聲，以佛羅里達大學美式足球賽為例，形容9萬名觀眾即使身處悶熱球場，仍能在第三節齊聲高唱，鼓勵員工繼續團結合作。
「我相信你們每一個人，都會一起唱出那首歌。」她說，「輝達，我們做得到。」
對員工釋出薪酬承諾之前，克瑞斯已在週二(17日)的第三季法說會上，向投資人說明領導交接期間的營運與財務方向，重點包括穩定人才、確保供應，以及持續回饋股東。
當時，美銀證券分析師詢問，面對重大人事變動，克瑞斯將如何向市場說明人才留任、營運韌性與財務策略。
她回應，穩定員工團隊「可能是目前最重要的事情」。
「我們一直把員工放在心上。就像任何群體一樣，公司內部也存在不同意見。」她表示，「我們會在過渡期間照顧員工，確保他們感到安全，也確保工作能在目前的環境下持續推進。」
在營運方面，輝達第三季營收與獲利均優於市場預期，並將2028會計年度營收成長預期由70%上調至75%。
克瑞斯表示，公司目前「一切照常」，客戶、供應商與合作夥伴都「百分之百支持我們」。由於產品需求持續高於供給，公司正積極確保供應，並支持供應商擴充產能，這也是提高成長預期的重要基礎。
「無論是眼前的需求、供應，或是達成75%的成長，我們都有信心。」她說。
在資本配置方面，克瑞斯表示，支持供應商增加產能是資金投入的首要任務；至於回饋股東，運用現有股票回購授權則是「最優先事項」。
輝達9月新增1,500億美元回購授權，截至第三季底，尚有2,273億美元額度可供執行。克瑞斯表示，公司有能力在2028會計年度結束前，完成現有回購計畫。
「綜合考量這些因素，我認為我們確實有能力持續執行所有希望推動的股票回購計畫，並在2028會計年度結束前完成。」她說。
《The Motley Fool》分析指出，若輝達完成上述回購，且股價大致維持目前水準，到了2028年1月、也就是2028會計年度結束時，流通在外股數可能減少約6%，有助支撐每股盈餘；實際效果仍取決於回購價格與執行情況。
瓊斯也在週二法說會上明確表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳回鍋重掌執行長職位。
對於正式接班人的任命時程，他說：「我們希望盡快讓正式執行長就任，但在找到真正合適的人選之前，不會為了加快速度而倉促任命。」
輝達股價週三(18日) 震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang resigned, acting CEO and CFO Colette Kress on Wednesday (the 18th) pledged at the first all‑staff meeting to implement a pay raise in December and increase equity awards, moving the schedule up by several months to reassure employees. Chairman Harvey Jones reiterated that the board is evaluating both internal and external CEO candidates and will not lower its standards to speed up the appointment.
According to a transcript obtained by WIRED, Kress took the stage for only a few minutes, cutting straight to the employee compensation issue.
She disclosed that roughly 700 questions were submitted beforehand, with compensation being the top concern, followed by calls for greater board transparency.
"I’m here to tell you that our top priority is taking care of every employee here, ensuring you have confidence in the company and don’t have to worry about your pay," Kress said.
This all‑hands meeting marked the new leadership team’s first direct briefing to the entire workforce after Huang’s departure.

Huang, who co‑founded the company 33 years ago, had long been the face of the quarterly employee town halls, a tradition eagerly awaited by staff. Now the chip giant, with nearly 49,000 employees, faces the dual challenge of leadership transition and talent retention.
Many long‑tenured staff members attribute their loyalty to Huang’s vision and leadership style.
Amid intensifying competition in AI chips, the management shake‑up raises concerns about potential talent loss, a risk watched closely by the market.
Even though thousands of employees have voiced support for Huang’s return and tech industry figures have signed an open petition, the board continues to press forward with the succession search.
Chairman Jones told the Wednesday staff meeting that the board accepted Huang’s resignation, citing personal conduct issues and a "failure to be forthright."

He stressed the company will not look for a "carbon copy" of Huang, but rather a leader with intelligence, high‑tech engineering experience, strategic thinking, cultural fit and a proven track record.
"We won’t lower our standards for the sake of speed," Jones said, adding the board is open to employee suggestions on the CEO choice and is simultaneously evaluating internal and external candidates.
Huang stepped down last week amid an extramarital affair scandal, with allegations that one of the involved parties may have ties to Chinese intelligence, a matter still under investigation.
Beyond pay and succession, preserving the company culture was a central theme of the meeting.
Co‑founder Chris Malachowsky, in a brief Q&A with Kress, said culture isn’t about slogans on the wall but about everyday behavior, collaboration and work habits.
He recalled that the founding team once dismissed the idea of printing cultural values on posters as "meaningless," insisting that real importance lies in living those values through work.
He believes those values will stand the test of time and told employees, "We’ll be okay."

Kress closed the roughly 50‑minute session by likening the audience to a 90,000‑person college football crowd at the University of Florida, where fans sang in unison in a sweltering stadium, urging staff to stay united and cooperative.
"I believe each of you will join in that song," she said. "Nvidia, we can do it."

Before making the compensation promise, Kress had addressed investors at the Q3 earnings call on Tuesday (the 17th), outlining operational and financial direction during the leadership transition, emphasizing talent stability, supply assurance, and continued shareholder returns.
At that call, a Bank of America analyst asked how Kress would explain talent retention, operational resilience and financial strategy to the market amid the major personnel change.
She replied that stabilizing the employee team "may be the most important thing right now."

"We always keep employees at heart. Like any group, there are differing opinions within the company," she said. "We’ll look after staff during the transition, make sure they feel safe, and keep work progressing under current conditions."
Operationally, Nvidia’s Q3 revenue and profit both beat market expectations, and the company raised its FY2028 revenue growth outlook from 70% to 75%.

Kress said the business is "business as usual," with customers, suppliers and partners "100% behind us." Ongoing strong product demand over supply is prompting the firm to secure supply and help suppliers expand capacity, a key driver of the higher growth outlook.
"Whether it’s current demand, supply, or achieving 75% growth, we’re confident," she added.

Regarding capital allocation, Kress said supporting supplier capacity expansion is the top priority for capital deployment; returning cash to shareholders via the existing stock‑repurchase authorization is the "number‑one priority."

Nvidia added a $150 billion share‑repurchase authorization in September; as of the end of Q3, $227.3 billion remains available. Kress said the company can complete the current repurchase plan before the end of FY2028.
"Taking all these factors together, I believe we indeed have the capacity to continue executing all intended share‑repurchase programs and finish them by the close of FY2028," she said.

The Motley Fool noted that if Nvidia completes the repurchases and the stock price stays roughly flat, the outstanding share count could shrink by about 6% by January 2028—the end of FY2028—supporting earnings per share; the actual impact will depend on repurchase pricing and execution.
Jones also made it clear at Tuesday’s earnings call that the board has no intention of reinstating Huang as CEO.
On the timeline for naming a permanent successor, he said, "We want to appoint a permanent CEO as soon as possible, but we will not rush a hasty appointment before we find the right person."
Nvidia’s stock on Wednesday (the 18th) wavered into the red, closing down 2.89% at $150.96, marking a 13.11% decline over five trading days since Huang’s resignation was announced.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Strengthens as Hawkish Fed Official Backs Aggressive Action
paras: 美元週三(18日)週三走強，升至19個月來新高，受到美國聯準會(Fed)官員華勒(Christopher Waller)的鷹派談話，以及近期經濟數據影響，市場對下個月升息的預期更加確立。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.78，創2025年4月以來最高。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)拒絕提供未來政策指引，使投資人更加依賴經濟數據，以及其他決策官員的談話，來判斷聯準會下一步動向。
華勒接受CNBC訪問時表示，如果央行希望降低通膨，就必須採取更「積極的行動」，包括在12月會議升息半個百分點，或是在會後聲明中引導市場預期，為進一步升息做好準備。
上週公布的通膨數據高於預期，使市場完全反映聯準會12月升息25個基點的預期，同時認為升息50個基點仍存在小幅可能性。芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，週二公布數據指出，美國10月零售銷售溫和成長，進一步強化市場對下個月升息的預期。
Monex USA駐華盛頓交易部門資深總監Juan Perez表示，「目前聯準會似乎非常堅定的準備升息，甚至可能採取更激進的升息方式。」
Perez指出，「這正是目前支撐美元走強的市場信念。」
不過，策略師也警告，美元若要延續升勢，可能需要新的利多催化因素。
Pepperstone研究策略師Dilin Wu表示，「若要推動美元從目前水準進一步顯著走高，市場可能需要開始反映2027年更為激進的升息路徑。」
CME FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期，12個月後聯準會基準利率將較目前上升約75個基點，來到4.50%至4.75%的區間。投資人也將密切關注紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)、聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)，以及明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)稍晚的談話，以判斷央行下一步政策方向。
美元漲勢已將其他主要貨幣推向數個月來低點。
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.09735美元，盤中一度觸及2025年4月以來最低。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.3%，至1.3165美元，創一個月來新低。數據顯示，英國10月核心通膨率與前一個月持平，降低市場對英格蘭銀行(BoE)即將升息的預期。
日元大致持平，報159.29日元兌1美元。日本央行(BoJ)總裁植田和男重申，貨幣政策仍有進一步緊縮的必要。日元目前仍接近日本政府今年7月曾進場干預、試圖支撐疲弱日元時的價位。
市場也關注預定於週四在深圳舉行的三方會談，與會者包括美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平，以及俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)。會談可能涉及俄羅斯對烏克蘭的戰爭、伊朗戰爭，以及貿易、AI與核武等議題。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 18th), reaching a 19‑month high, boosted by hawkish comments from Fed official Christopher Waller and recent economic data, solidifying market expectations of a rate hike next month.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.78, the highest since April 2025.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refused to provide forward guidance, causing investors to rely more on economic data and remarks from other policymakers to gauge the Fed’s next move.

In a CNBC interview, Waller said that if the central bank wants to bring inflation down, it must take more “aggressive action,” including a 0.5‑percentage‑point rate hike at the December meeting or guiding market expectations in the post‑meeting statement to prepare for further hikes.

Last week’s inflation data came in hotter than expected, leading the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December while still seeing a small chance of a 50‑basis‑point increase. CME Group’s FedWatch tool showed that Tuesday’s data, which reported modest growth in U.S. retail sales for October, further reinforced expectations of a rate hike next month.
Juan Perez, senior director of Monex USA’s Washington trading desk, said, “The Fed now appears very resolute in preparing to raise rates, and may even adopt a more aggressive tightening path.”
Perez added, “That is the market belief currently underpinning the dollar’s strength.”
However, strategists warned that for the dollar to keep climbing, a new bullish catalyst may be needed.

Dilin Wu, a strategist at Pepperstone, said, “To push the dollar significantly higher from current levels, the market may need to start pricing in a more aggressive rate‑hike trajectory through 2027.”

CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect the Fed’s benchmark rate to be about 75 basis points higher in 12 months, landing in the 4.50%‑4.75% range. Investors will also watch later remarks from New York Fed President John Williams, Fed Governor Michael Barr, and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari to gauge the central bank’s next policy step.
The dollar’s rally has pushed other major currencies toward multi‑month lows.
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.09735, briefly touching its lowest level since April 2025.
The pound slipped 0.3% to $1.3165, a one‑month low. Data showed Britain’s core inflation for October held steady month‑over‑month, easing market expectations of an imminent BoE rate hike.

The yen was roughly flat at ¥159.29 per dollar. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated that monetary policy still needs further tightening. The yen remains near the level the Japanese government intervened at in July this year to support the weak currency.

Markets also focused on the three‑way summit scheduled for Thursday in Shenzhen, attended by U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The talks could cover Russia’s war in Ukraine, the Iran conflict, as well as trade, AI and nuclear issues.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Minimum Price Increment for High‑Priced Stocks Changed to NT$1, APEC Summit Held, AI Stocks Hit Massive Default Deliveries
paras:
台股盤前要聞

items.title_en: Rare Chain Reaction! Massive Default Deliveries Hit AI Chain, 9 Stocks Including Creative and Wistron Total NT$427 Million
paras: 受輝達(NVIDIA)共同創辦人黃仁勳下台消息衝擊，全球AI產業鏈劇烈震盪，拖累台股 16 日重挫，依據「T+2」交割制度，今(18)日交割日，證交所及櫃買中心同步公告，上市櫃共計多達9檔個股爆出鉅額違約交割，合計違約總金額高達4億2,694萬6,248元，且清一色集中於AI伺服器、散熱、PCB及半導體供應鏈。

其中，ASIC設計大廠創意違約金額高達9,453萬元居冠，由中信託忠、玉山景美兩家分點申報；PCB大廠華通違約金額達9,360萬3,500元居次，申報券商包括華南台南、兆豐松德、國泰館前、群益海山、國泰敦二等5家分點。
載板大廠欣興違約金額為5,204萬2,746元，申報分點多達15家，涵蓋國泰敦南、國泰敦二、華南淡水、元大莒光、永豐天母、凱基松山、永豐板盛、群益鳳山、第一彰化、國泰館前、元大松山、富邦經紀、永豐金、元大雙和與元大永寧；AI伺服器板大廠金像電則有2,616萬3,000元違約交割，由永豐敦南、永豐板盛、永豐金、國泰敦南、元大松山、國泰館前、國泰敦三、華南頭份等8家分點申報。
上櫃市場同樣災情慘重，共有雙鴻(3324-TW)、精材(3374-TW)、穩懋(3105-TW)、精測(6510-TW)與金山電(8042-TW)等5檔個股出現鉅額違約，合計金額達1億6,060萬7,002元。

paras_en: The resignation of NVIDIA co‑founder Jensen Huang sent shockwaves through the global AI supply chain, dragging Taiwan stocks down sharply on the 16th. Under the T+2 settlement system, today (the 18th) the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced that a total of nine listed and OTC stocks suffered massive default settlements, amounting to NT$4,269,466,248, all concentrated in AI servers, cooling, PCB and semiconductor supply chains.

According to the latest disclosures from the TWSE and the OTC market, four listed stocks and five OTC stocks met the default settlement reporting threshold today. In the main market, Creative (3443‑TW), Wistron (2313‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW) and Goldensun (2368‑TW) were listed, with a combined default amount of NT$2,663,390,246.

Among them, ASIC designer Creative led with a default of NT$94,530,000, reported by two branches of CTBC Trust and E.SUN Jingmei; PCB giant Wistron posted a default of NT$93,603,500, reported by five broker branches: Hua Nan Tainan, Mega Songde, Cathay Guandian, KGI Haishan and Cathay Dun‑II.

Unimicron’s default was NT$52,042,746, reported by as many as 15 branches, including Cathay Dun‑South, Cathay Dun‑II, Hua Nan Tamsui, Yuanta Juguang, SinoPac Tianmu, KGI Songshan, SinoPac Ban‑Sheng, KGI Fengshan, First Changhua, Cathay Guandian, Yuanta Songshan, Fubon Brokerage, SinoPac, Yuanta Shuanghe and Yuanta Yongning. AI‑server maker Goldensun defaulted NT$26,163,000, reported by eight branches: SinoPac Dun‑South, SinoPac Ban‑Sheng, SinoPac, Cathay Dun‑South, Yuanta Songshan, Cathay Guandian, Cathay Dun‑III and Hua Nan Toufen.

The OTC market suffered similarly severe fallout, with five stocks—Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), Jingcai (3374‑TW), Wenmao (3105‑TW), Jingce (6510‑TW) and Jinshan Electronics (8042‑TW)—recording massive defaults totaling NT$1,606,070,002.

In the OTC segment, cooling‑equipment maker Shuang Hong had the largest default at NT$64,656,000, reported by three branches: Qiyin Pujian, Hua Nan Nanjing and Taishin Taichung. TSMC‑related stock Jingcai defaulted NT$40,010,902, reported by six branches: Heku Kaohsiung, Cathay Dun‑II, Yuanta Keelung, SinoPac Dun‑South, SinoPac and Taishin Dayu.

Gallium‑arsenide specialist Wenmao defaulted NT$34,062,500, reported by a dozen branches including First Changhua, Guopiao Boai, Cathay Xinzhuang, Cathay Dun‑II, Cathay Dun‑III, KGI Haishan, KGI Yongkang, Yuanta Keelung, SinoPac, SinoPac Taichung, SinoPac Yawan and SinoPac Taoyuan. Test‑interface firm Jingce defaulted NT$11,860,000 (reported by E.SUN Jingmei) and passive component maker Jinshan Electronics defaulted NT$10,017,600 (reported by CTBC Trust).

Market analysts note that today’s broker‑branch filings show not only single branches like CTBC Trust and E.SUN Jingmei simultaneously defaulting on multiple high‑price and AI stocks, but also rare cases where 15 branches reported Creative and 12 branches reported Wenmao at the same time. This reflects the severe cash‑flow and settlement pressure on both major investors and short‑term traders after the sudden negative news drove prices sharply lower.

Investors are reminded that international tech news is changing rapidly. When trading highly volatile stocks or engaging in day‑trading, they should carefully assess their financial capacity and risk tolerance, and continuously verify that settlement accounts have sufficient funds to avoid default deliveries that could damage personal credit records and incur legal liabilities.

items.title: 優群伺服器、電信訂單逐步放量 明年營運拚雙位數成長
items.title_en: Yugong's Server and Telecom Orders Gradually Increase, Targeting Double-Digit Growth Next Year
paras: 連接器廠優群(3217-TW)今(18)日召開法說會，總經理劉興義表示，受筆電市場需求疲弱、記憶體缺料及價格上漲影響，今年營運承壓，不過隨著伺服器及電信相關產品逐步放量，明年營運可望重返成長軌道，目標營收年增雙位數，獲利也將挑戰今年水準。
劉興義指出，今年筆電市場受到記憶體缺料及價格上漲影響，部分機種改採On-board形式出貨，降低SO-DIMM連接器需求，加上終端銷售下滑，使SO-DIMM及M.2產品營收均受到衝擊。不過，公司觀察，客戶長期仍偏好採用記憶體模組形式，隨著供應鏈逐步改善，On-board應屬過渡性做法。
展望明年，劉興義指出，成長動能主要來自伺服器及電信客戶，並非預期筆電市場復甦，因此公司對NB相關產品仍採較保守的估算。Server方面，Google相關專案已於11月進行首次試產，預計明年第一季量產，且客戶希望由越南廠生產，將有助於營收成長及越南廠稼動率提升。
此外，優群也積極布局高階伺服器記憶體應用，包括SO CAMM，目前已與客戶進行試產及送樣，並有機會取得雲端伺服器客戶的Vendor Code，若順利導入量產，將帶來進一步的營收貢獻。
電信訂單則自第三季起陸續進入量產，第四季及明年出貨可望延續成長，預估明年電信營收占比將由今年約5%提升至10%，占比倍增。整體產品應用結構也將有所調整，筆電占比預計由今年約65%降至明年約50%，桌機及伺服器合計占比則可望由今年約14%提升至20%，降低對單一應用市場的依賴。
新產品方面，CAMM第三季出貨較前季大幅成長，單月出貨量高點已接近10萬個，低點則約5萬個。原先預期明年第一、二季逐步擴大導入的HP機種，目前量產時程未變，但實際出貨數量仍須視客戶取得記憶體模組的情況而定。優群也預期，隨著Lenovo及HP高階機種陸續導入，CAMM明年可望逐步挹注營收。
越南廠方面，優群已開始規劃微型沖壓件於當地生產，明年也將陸續導入DDR Long DIMM及微型沖壓件，提供客戶第二生產基地。劉興義表示，越南廠目前產值仍相對有限，但隨著新產品及訂單移入，明年稼動率可望改善，並開始看到損益兩平的跡象。
劉興義表示，今年營收估將呈現年減，毛利率也可能進一步下滑；明年營收目標則希望達雙位數成長，隨著營收及產能利用率回升，毛利率也可望優於今年。若明年毛利率能維持今年下半年的水準，全年獲利將有機會挑戰今年表現。
paras_en: Yugong (3217-TW) held a financial briefing today (18th) where General Manager Liu Xingyi noted that the weak laptop market demand, memory shortages, and price hikes have pressured this year's operations. However, as server and telecom products gradually ramp up, the company expects operations to return to growth next year, targeting double-digit revenue growth and challenging last year's profitability.

Liu highlighted that this year's laptop market was affected by memory shortages and price increases, leading some models to switch to on-board configurations, reducing demand for SO-DIMM connectors. Coupled with declining end‑user sales, revenues from SO-DIMM and M.2 products were impacted. Nevertheless, the company observes that customers still prefer memory module formats long term, and on‑board is a transitional approach as the supply chain improves.

Looking ahead to next year, Liu said growth will mainly come from server and telecom customers, not from a laptop market rebound, so the company remains conservative on notebook products. In the server segment, a Google‑related project had its first pilot production in November, with mass production expected in Q1 next year. Customers also prefer production in Vietnam, which will help revenue growth and improve the Vietnam plant’s utilization.

Yugong is also actively developing high‑end server memory applications, including SO‑CAMM. Trials and sample deliveries are underway with customers, and there is a chance to secure a vendor code from cloud server clients. Successful mass production would further contribute to revenue.

Telecom orders began entering mass production from Q3, with Q4 and next year expected to continue growing. Telecom revenue is projected to rise from about 5% this year to 10% next year, doubling its share. The overall product mix will shift: laptop share is expected to drop from about 65% this year to 50% next year, while desktop and server combined share should rise from about 14% to 20%, reducing reliance on a single market.

Regarding new products, CAMM shipments in Q3 grew sharply compared to the previous quarter, with monthly highs near 100,000 units and lows around 50,000. The HP models initially planned for phased introduction in Q1 and Q2 next year remain on schedule, but actual shipments depend on customers securing memory modules. Yugong expects that as Lenovo and HP high‑end models roll out, CAMM will gradually contribute to revenue next year.

In Vietnam, Yugong has begun planning micro‑stamping components for local production and will gradually introduce DDR Long DIMM and micro‑stamping parts next year, providing a second production base for customers. Liu noted that the Vietnam plant’s output is still limited, but with new products and orders moving in, next year’s utilization should improve, showing signs of breakeven.

Liu stated that this year’s revenue is expected to decline, with gross margin potentially falling further. Next year’s revenue target is double‑digit growth, and as revenue and capacity utilization rebound, gross margin should exceed this year’s. If next year’s gross margin maintains the level of the second half of this year, annual profit could challenge last year’s performance.
